name: Audio and Video
description: Transcribing, converting, subtitling and editing sound and video.
note: This is an audio and video project. Keep the original files untouched and write results beside them, state the format, codec and length of what you produce, and say what a conversion loses.
details: Sound and video work with ffmpeg, whisper (speech to text), yt-dlp and the music tools. The agent keeps your original files untouched and writes results beside them, and states the format, codec and length of what it produces so you can check it.
examples: Convert a folder of recordings to MP3 and even out the loudness
Transcribe an interview with Whisper and cut the best minute
Pull the audio of a lecture to listen to on the move
Make subtitles for a video and burn them in

tools.why: convert, trim, extract the sound, make frames, burn subtitles
transcribe speech to text or subtitles
fetch audio or video you have the right to download
check, convert and re-time subtitle files
